description: Repo-scale (sql-ecommerce): a new loyalty_tier column must actually drive a discounted total in the view, not just exist
prompts: Add a `loyalty_tier` column to `customers` in schema.sql (TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'bronze', CHECK constrained to 'bronze'/'silver'/'gold'). Add a `discounted_total_cents` column to the `customer_order_totals` view in views.sql, applying a tier-based discount to the existing `total_cents`: gold gets 10% off, silver gets 5% off, bronze gets no discount - round to the nearest cent. Adding the column alone is not the point: `discounted_total_cents` must actually reflect each customer's `loyalty_tier`, not just duplicate `total_cents` unmodified. `product_sales_summary` is unaffected.

reference_solution.views.sql:
CREATE VIEW customer_order_totals AS
SELECT c.id AS customer_id,
       c.name,
       COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents), 0) AS total_cents,
       CAST(ROUND(
           COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents), 0) *
           (CASE c.loyalty_tier
                WHEN 'gold' THEN 0.90
                WHEN 'silver' THEN 0.95
                ELSE 1.0
            END)
       ) AS INTEGER) AS discounted_total_cents
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.loyalty_tier;

CREATE VIEW product_sales_summary AS
SELECT p.id AS product_id,
       p.name,
       COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS units_sold
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name;

       c.name,
       COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents), 0) AS total_cents,
       COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents), 0) AS discounted_total_cents
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name;

CREATE VIEW product_sales_summary AS
SELECT p.id AS product_id,
       p.name,
       COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS units_sold
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name;
